title: Run reads teach field selection and continuation
current: CLI list returns byte-bounded summary rows with next_cursor and a detail recipe. Multi-field get selects only named columns; single-field get returns its scalar. Shipping overview remains an explicit rich read. Failed start-timing records carry reason_code from the typed refusal or exception type in both raw capture and persisted timings. Older serving contracts refuse with the required read capability and individual-field recovery. Creation collects timing records into start_timings on local and HTTPS transports; the compact CLI receipt saves them to complete private evidence instead of streaming and repeating the table.
verification: Source tests cover exact field selection, default JSON and human output bytes, Unicode byte paging, stable equal-timestamp continuation, restricted visibility and older-server refusal.
